def logloss_multiclass(y_true, y_pred):
    # y_true: shape (N, M) binary one-hot or vectorized labels
    # y_pred: shape (N, M) predicted probabilities
    N = y_true.shape[0]
    M = y_true.shape[1]

    eps = 1e-15
    y_true = y_true.clip(eps, 1 - eps)
